lastCompletedStory.title: Broaden the fixture matrix and record the accepted detection trade-off

nextStoryContext: US-002 (CAM-388) broadened test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt from 5 to 10 rows: added an ok+flag pair for grep-q-plus-list-files and for zero-match-vacuous (previously entirely absent from the fixture), and an ok row for rotating-artifact-target (previously flag-only), while keeping every US-001 frozen-comparand row untouched. AC1's shape-guard oracle and AC2's classify-every-row oracle were both already GREEN before this story touched anything (US-001's frozen-comparand rows already happened to satisfy the four required shapes), so the actual delta this story delivers is (a) the other two rules no longer being vacuously absent from the fixture, (b) a new bun-test describe block ('oracle-lint-cases.txt fixture matrix' in test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts) that drives every fixture row through RULES and asserts it via `bun test`, not just via the review-time shell oracle, and (c) a new scripts/cam/patterns.md bullet (US-002, CAM-388, right after the US-001 quote-stripping bullet) that documents the ACCEPTED blind spot: stripQuotedSpans/isDashCWrapper only unwraps a `-c '<payload>'` wrapper, never a `-e '<payload>'` one, so a live frozen-integer comparison hidden inside a `bun -e '...'` or `node -e '...'` payload is structurally invisible to frozen-comparand -- two of the three replayed CAM-382 incident commands are exactly that shape. This is a deliberate, documented trade-off (widening the unwrap to -e risks resurrecting the original CAM-382 false-positive class), not an open bug; a future story that wants -e coverage must add a fixture row proving the CAM-382 replay fixture (test/fixtures/oracle-lint/cam382-false-positives.txt) still passes before landing. `bun run check:all` (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps) is fully green at this commit; no other CAM-381/CAM-382/CAM-383/CAM-386 items were touched.
